author: sandmrk
text:
Seedance 2.5 Video Prompt:

Global lock: Vertical 9:16, one single continuous locked-off shot, 7.5 seconds. Semi-realistic CG render with fine 3D detail and soft cinematic skin shading — not live-action footage, not flat anime. Character: one young woman with a platinum-white wavy bob and bangs, a gold cuff bracelet, fine silver arm chains, and a thin gold chain band on her right thigh. Costume: a pale lilac-pink glossy satin halter qipao gown — cross-halter neckline with small gold ornaments, a fitted bodice, a SHORT front skirt with long sheer train panels falling from both hips, and an open back closed by corset lacing down the spine with one fine beaded chain draped along her back. Setting: a dark luxurious interior, gold floral painted wall panels, one tall arched standing mirror at frame right, black glossy floor reflecting the light. Spatial logic: she stands before the mirror slightly left of center, the mirror occupying the right 35 percent of the frame; the mirror always shows her BACK or three-quarter back while the camera sees whichever side she presents — the two views stay consistent with each other. Framing: full body, about 88 percent of frame height frontal, face about 10 percent. Lighting: warm amber interior glow, soft key on her front, a bright rim tracing the white curls and the satin sheen. Audio: a fast pop dance track at 129.2 BPM, no dialogue. Emotion arc: a poised back-view mystery — a bright hair-flip reveal — playful open groove — a slow composed settle, the mirror keeping her back the whole way.

[00:00-00:01] Pure back view: she stands before the mirror, back to the camera, hands low — a fine beaded chain dangling from her right hand — swaying almost imperceptibly; the mirror catches her profile.
[00:01-00:02] She turns to face the camera in one motion, white curls flying out with the spin, and lands facing front.
[00:02-00:04] In-place groove: both palms turn up and wave lightly at shoulder height, hips swaying, small steps in place, expression bright with lips parted.
[00:04-00:06] Palms push forward and sweep out in alternation, weight shifting side to side on the beat, the sheer trains swinging softly.
[00:06-00:07] She turns to her left profile, arms lowering behind her back, and slowly rotates back toward the front, settling still as the clip ends — the mirror showing her back throughout.

Negative constraints: no camera movement, no cut, no second real person (the reflection is her own and must stay geometrically consistent), no reflection showing her face while her back is turned, no costume or hairstyle change, no lacing or train morphing, no extra fingers, no text, no watermark, no logo.
This is a reverse-engineered prompt; the generated result cannot fully match the original video and needs further optimization.
